relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: The SustainedR and LateR groups showed statistically significant anxiety and depression score reduction at M3 and M6 compared to the other groups.

key_findings: In 357 resistant migraine patients, 37% had sustained response, 16.8% late response, and 13.1% no response to anti-CGRP mAbs over 6 months.
Persistent anxiety and depression may be associated with lower response rates at 6 months.
